title: Regulation of microglia inflammation and oligodendrocyte demyelination by Engeletin via the TLR4/RRP9/NF-kappaB pathway after spinal cord injury.
authors: Chen, Wang; Zhang, Leshu; Zhong, Guangdi; Liu, Shuang; Sun, Yuxuan; Zhang, Jiayun; Liu, Zehan; Wang, Lichun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究脊髓损伤后小胶质细胞炎症与少突胶质脱髓鞘的调控机制，涉及小分子-蛋白对接和蛋白-蛋白互作，但核心是信号通路与炎症，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Microglia polarization is crucial for neuroinflammatory response after spinal cord injury (SCI). Small molecule compounds and hub genes play an important role in regulating microglia polarization, reducing neuroinflammatory response and oligodendrocyte demyelination after SCI. In this study, suitable data sets were used to screen hub genes, and Western blot and Immunofluorescence (IF) experiments were used to confirm the expressions of proteins related to SDAD1, RRP9 and NF-kappaB pathways under LPS/SCI conditions. Engeletin (ENG) reduced microglia polarization and inflammation in vivo and in vitro via the SDAD1, RRP9 or NF-kappaB signaling pathways. In addition, ENG binds to the membrane receptor Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) through small molecule-protein docking. COIP experiment and protein-protein docking revealed protein-protein interaction (PPI) between RRP9 and SDAD1. By gene knock-down (KD) / overexpression (OE) and Western blot experiments, RRP9 and SDAD1 can regulate inflammatory response through NF-kappaB signaling and ribosome biogenesis pathway. Western blot analysis showed that CU increased the expression of SDAD1, RRP9 and NF-kappaB pathway related proteins through TLR1/2, while C34 decreased the expression of SDAD1 and RRP9 proteins through TLR4. These results suggest that ENG can reduce inflammation through TLR4/RRP9(SDAD1)/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. In addition, we demonstrated that oligodendrocyte apoptosis and demyelination could be influenced by the regulation of microglia and tissue inflammation. In conclusion, this study found the gene Rrp9/Sdad1 and the small molecule compound ENG, which control the inflammatory response of microglia, and further explored the related mechanism of oligodendrocyte demyelination, which has important theoretical significance.
abstract_zh: 小胶质细胞极化对脊髓损伤（SCI）后的神经炎症反应至关重要。小分子化合物和枢纽基因在调节小胶质细胞极化、减轻SCI后神经炎症反应及少突胶质细胞脱髓鞘中发挥重要作用。本研究利用合适的数据集筛选枢纽基因，并通过Western blot和免疫荧光（IF）实验确认LPS/SCI条件下与SDAD1、RRP9及NF-kappaB通路相关蛋白的表达。恩格列汀（ENG）通过SDAD1、RRP9或NF-kappaB信号通路在体内外减少小胶质细胞极化和炎症。此外，ENG通过小分子-蛋白质对接与膜受体Toll样受体4（TLR4）结合。COIP实验和蛋白质-蛋白质对接揭示了RRP9与SDAD1之间的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）。通过基因敲低（KD）/过表达（OE）及Western blot实验，RRP9和SDAD1可通过NF-kappaB信号和核糖体生物发生通路调节炎症反应。Western blot分析显示，CU通过TLR1/2增加SDAD1、RRP9及NF-kappaB通路相关蛋白的表达，而C34通过TLR4降低SDAD1和RRP9蛋白的表达。这些结果表明，ENG可通过TLR4/RRP9(SDAD1)/NF-kappaB信号通路减轻炎症。此外，我们证明了少突胶质细胞凋亡和脱髓鞘可受小胶质细胞和组织炎症调节的影响。总之，本研究发现了控制小胶质细胞炎症反应的基因Rrp9/Sdad1及小分子化合物ENG，并进一步探讨了少突胶质细胞脱髓鞘的相关机制，具有重要的理论意义。
